Heights, names and sky, all baked in.

Moon heights: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit (LRO LOLA)
Mars heights: NASA PDS MOLA MEGDR
Earth heights: NOAA ETOPO
Mars and Earth colour: Solar System Scope (CC BY 4.0)
Moon and Mars names: IAU / USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature
Earth names: Natural Earth
Stars: HYG database (CC BY-SA 4.0)
Deep sky and constellations: d3-celestial

Landing site orbit photos: NASA / GSFC / Arizona State University, LROC
Apollo Lunar Module model: NASA 3D Resources
Other models: tashtego, Akimkhan (after sheffrator), akareactor and sohamr.sr on Sketchfab (CC BY 4.0; Luna 9 CC BY-NC 4.0)
True scale terrain: LROC NAC DTMs, NASA / GSFC / Arizona State University

Built with three.js. Type: Doto (SIL OFL).
